services.name: Signature Haircut
services.description: Tailored precision skin fade, drop fade, low taper, scissor crop, or classic cut. Includes hot lather neck lineup and styling.

services.name: Haircut & Beard Sculpting
services.description: The crowd pleezer combo. Precision cut with beard trim, straight razor line shaping, hot towel, and nourishing beard oil.

services.name: Razor Edge Lineup
services.description: Quick neckline and hairline cleaning. Sharp edging on temples and sideburns with a hot lather razor touchup.

services.name: Kid's Precision Cut
services.description: Patient, friendly styling for children ages 12 & under. Cool tapers, skin fades, or scissor crops.

services.name: Senior Gentleman Cut
services.description: Classic scissor cut, trim, and clean neckline feathering for seniors 65 & over.

services.name: Braids & Locs Styling
services.description: Professional braiding, cornrows, box braids, or starter locs/retwists. Handled by our specialist stylists.

reviews.author: Marcus Rodriguez
reviews.role: Regular • Cut by Mir The Barber
reviews.text: Cleanest taper in Las Vegas. Mir takes his time and gets the lineup surgically straight. The shop vibe is friendly and energetic.

reviews.author: Andre Lewis
reviews.text: Hairanesa is the truth. Got my cornrows done super neat, and got a fresh taper right after in the same chair. Saves so much time.

reviews.author: David Thompson
reviews.text: Major Fadez gave me the best drop fade I've had. Super fast, professional, and took me in right away. Worth every dollar.
